title: Helping Tom Albert pay for his house; why he left
summary: He stayed with Albert to help him pay off his home, left when music slowed and he needed money, with Albert's blessing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Did that a musician like your playing in the audience when you first got down? I mean, how did they feel about it? Did they say much about it?

Well, yeah, they, they, they all seemed to like it very well. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. I had a lot of opportunities to sit here in their band. They were doing a lot of work. Uh-huh. I was leaving, uh, stuck right there with him, because I was making money for him and he was buying that home he's got right now. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And he was in debt. And, uh, I could help him pay for it. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And, uh, I was too glad to help him pay for it, because he gave me a real, you know, Sure, where he'll start, yeah. Yeah, so I just stayed with, stayed there with him until he paid for him, paid for that home. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And we all pitched in and moved him from where he was living in 515 or, uh, off A Street. Uh-huh. And, uh, we, uh, pitched in and moved him where he was not, since 35 McGonagall Street.
Uh-huh. What caused you to leave the band in the end, you know, wouldn't you?

Yes, uh, the music had got slow, things had got kind of, you know, bad. With Tom's band or with all the bands? Yeah, with all the bands, right. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And I had gotten married then, and, uh, expecting my first child and I needed some money. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. To Johnson had been after me for about six or eight months to come up and join his band. He thought it was a pretty good salary. And, uh, I sit down and talk to Mr. Tom about it. And, uh, he told me I'd be a fool if I didn't go take him. Because he was gonna give up in this anyway. Uh-huh. Well, with that encouragement, I told him to come up there. So, they moved him down here and got me in a move, made a better way.
